name: aeroinsight
description: AeroInsight is an enterprise drone telemetry intelligence platform integrating Node.js, PostgreSQL/SQLite, React/Vite, Leaflet geospatial mapping, Google Gemini GenAI, and a Unity MCP 3D Digital Twin simulation suite.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'public', {recursive: true})"
